proposed_capability: P00/P01/P95/P141/P124 and Trifecta: Agent-controlled camera defaults to active Sim (Enter); only a fresh host-confirmed named target/goal creates a bounded map traversal exception, with mandatory return to active Sim before continuing. Preserve human control, host admission and no game saves.
player_save_control_impact: Changes only repository camera planning, declared host stack and admitted camera-traverse injected port; no Sims saves/installed mods/OS hooks touched. Default enter only through separate game Live-mode host approval and human idle gate. Never seize camera from player.
expected_outcome: Active Sim remains exclusive default agent-owned camera position. When named current target and goal require a temporary map traverse, the host uses a 30-second bounded lease with <=8 moves, then re-centers active Sim by Enter inside admitted finally and obtains fresh observation before next actions. Missing evidence, stale lease, or player input fails closed.
negative_tests: Generic scene scan does not authorize free pan
Unobserved street view generates active-Sim center gate
No Shift+Enter lot centering for Sim
No map traverse from unanchored active Sim
Unverified target, expired lease, changed goal, or agent-invented target blocks map move
Player camera ownership, text entry, modal or changed Sim yield
Injected host only attempts restoration with admitted focus/idle gate
No indefinite retry or background camera daemon
rollback_path: Revert PR through GitHub; no user saves/game files, workstation settings or live sessions mutated.
unresolved_unknowns: Physical Sims camera centering and post-traversal outcome need local Windows game-host observation; GitHub test run is not live gameplay certification.
Any external Playwright agents that ignore the canonical host port require their own entrypoint enforcement.
